agent_rules.summary: Consolidate observations when count >= 2 with same normalized value
Promote staging memory (2000-2099) to canonical (1000-1999) via toCanonicalIdSafe()
Create kairos_contradicts edges for conflicting memories on same topic_key
Newest created_ymdhis wins as default canonical truth
LLM summarizes only; consolidation decisions are deterministic PHP rules
